Before restoring, I could see the archived "Recipes I want to try" still carried both its Cooking and Weekend labels and my "Try the crispy roast potatoes for Sunday dinner" note — nothing was lost while it sat in the archive. Then restoring it emptied the Archived list back to zero and put it back among my bookmarks, with the little "Restored to All bookmarks" confirmation. So archiving really is a reversible tuck-away that keeps everything intact, clearly different from the permanent delete. That's exactly the pair I was after. What's next?
